title: My purchases
lead: Your private commitments with sellers. Order, payment, reservation, fulfillment, receipt and refund remain separate.
empty: No purchases on this page. A preparation or payment without a confirmed order may still appear in its dedicated status page.

serviceRequests.title: Services without online payment
serviceRequests.lead: Fixed-price services and accepted quotes involve no payment here, so they are not listed among your purchases. Their follow-up (status reported by the professional, appointment, order) is in My requests.

stale: Refresh this status before making another decision.
noSnapshot: This commitment’s details have not been loaded yet. Explicitly request a refresh.
receiptNotice: Receipt confirmation is separate from payment and does not trigger a payout from this screen.
settlement: Payout status reported by the server
settlementNotice: These indications do not prove any movement of funds beyond the explicitly reported status. No payout operation is executed here.
historyTruncated: This history is limited to the events provided; earlier events may be missing.
support: Contact the seller about this purchase
supportLead: This private channel is linked to your commitment, even when the storefront or offer is no longer public. Your message is not published.
messagesTruncated: Only messages provided in this window are displayed.
actionNote: A cancellation or return request is not automatically approved and does not constitute a refund.
refund: Request a refund in payment status
pending: An action is awaiting a certain result. Look up its status before another decision.
accepted: Action recorded by the server. Review the refreshed statuses above.
unknownAction: Result still unknown. The same action will be looked up before any repeat.
refused: This action is currently unavailable. No status is changed on your behalf.
notFound: The action was not found. You can resume the same action while its information remains available on this screen.
actionFailed: The response could not be confirmed. Keep this status page and look up the result.
offline: You are offline. Status remains readable; requests and messages are paused.
onlineReview: The network has returned. Refresh status and give new consent before making a decision.
scope: Up to {{count}} purchases per page. An empty page does not prove that no other purchases exist.
validationConsent: Your explicit receipt confirmation is required.
validationMessage: Enter a message of 1 to 1,000 characters without invalid characters.
